_doc: The powers you stand with and rank in (design/powers/powers-and-reputation-spec.md §3-4; build item N-7.3.3). powers: each power's name, its road (data/world/lives.json roads; the power you join by taking that road), its school, and start: its standing on the first morning (§3.2). Your road's power starts at road_start instead. Standing is start plus this life's bumps (Run.life standing, written by deeds.gd and the story's standing effect), held to -100..100; tiers name its bands by their lowest value (§3.1). ranks: the ladder in your road's power; you are its first rank from taking the road, and each later rank is taken at an examination (the story's exam effect) once its rows are met: standing with the power, the Ring, school spells known (spells), staged [n, stage]: n of them at that spell stage or above (1 Adept, 2 Master, 3 Perfected; Grandmaster's Grand spell is approximated by a Perfected one), and merit (earned only as a member, from the story's merit effect). Only Initiate and Adept are reachable in Ring 1; Master and Grandmaster show as rows to come.
